explanation.text: North Carolina’s highest summit, Mount Mitchell, has an elevation of 6,684 feet according to the USGS summit survey.
Tennessee’s highest summit, Clingmans Dome, has an elevation of 6,643 feet according to the USGS summit survey.
Mount Mitchell's elevation is greater than Clingmans Dome's by 41 feet.
The USGS data directly supports that North Carolina’s highest summit overtops Tennessee’s in elevation.
